The 'topology_boundary_auditor' confirmed a clean mask for the main subject, ruling out major fusion artifacts for the bird itself.
alignment_reasoning: The image strongly aligns with the 'pelican' class, confirmed by the fine_grained_classifier (Top-1: pelican). Key anatomical features (bill, pouch, wings, neck) are present and structurally sound. The addition of accessories (hat/sunglasses) does not obscure the fundamental class identity. 7/8 testable checkpoints passed. The failure of one checkpoint (bill color) is due to occlusion/lighting rather than structural absence. The pose auditor's low confidence in hind limbs is noted but visually attributed to occlusion and domain shift rather than definitive missing limbs.
artifact_reasoning: Minor artifacts are present. The accessories show slight texture inconsistency (painted look). The background structure exhibits geometric warping and perspective issues (severity 3), which detracts from the overall realism. Edge bleeding on the wings is minimal. The high pose uncertainty in the legs is a weak signal due to occlusion but prevents a perfect structural score. The image is not catastrophic but has noticeable AI-generation tells in the background and accessory integration.
